mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT PayType FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPay WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} ORDER BY PayNo LIMIT 1) AS payType, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tAdjAdjustDetail D WHERE D.OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND D.OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND (D.BuyAdjustCloseDate IS NOT NULL OR D.AdjustNo IS NOT NULL OR D.SaleAdjustCloseDate IS NOT NULL OR D.SaleAdjustNo IS NOT NULL)) AS closedCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tAdjAdjustDetail D WHERE D.OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND D.OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND D.BuyAdjustCloseDate IS NULL AND D.AdjustNo IS NULL AND D.SaleAdjustCloseDate IS NULL AND D.SaleAdjustNo IS NULL) AS openCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirect S WHERE S.OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND S.OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo}) AS shipCopyCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tShpReturnDirect R WHERE R.OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND R.OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo}) AS returnCopyCnt
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tOrdOrderProd SET SalePrice = #{salePrice}, SupplyPrice = #{supplyPrice}, BuyPrice = #{buyPrice}, VatAmt = #{vatAmt}, ProdMargin = #{prodMargin}, ChnlMargin = #{chnlMargin}, NetMargin = #{netMargin}, ReciptAmt = #{reciptAmt}, DeliFeeType = #{deliFeeType}, DeliFeeAmt = #{deliFeeAmt}, PromotFeeAmt = #{promotFeeAmt}, ChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName} WHERE OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo} AND OrderState = #{expectedState}
